title: Xdrip with big diferences from finger BG + Treatments on NightScout
body:
Good Morning
I have noticed in the last times differences that are not normal between the readings of the Libre by the Blucon and the measurements in the finger.
I noticed with the last versions of this month.
I went back to the one of October 15 that was working well, but in the last days it becomes difficult to be sure the values.
I've already used the Datricsae plugin as a recommendation and it's just the same.
https://www.dropbox.com/s/hwb7ekqwjy9rwyt/Screenshot_2018-11-13-09-53-06-035_com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip%5B1%5D.png?dl=0
https://www.dropbox.com/s/phx8snusub3rc4f/Screenshot_2018-11-13-09-52-56-394_com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip%5B1%5D.png?dl=0
https://www.dropbox.com/s/g6ctd0obgcwauka/Screenshot_2018-11-13-09-52-51-459_com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip%5B1%5D.png?dl=0

My daughter uses a Samsung J5 2016 with android 7.1.1.
I used Xdrip for almost 2 years when I had this kind of problem i calibrated with stable values and it was ok. Not now!
Is it Blucon's problem?
What help can you give me?

Another issue when I introduce a finger reading in Xdrip treatments does not appear in the NightScout reports. If put by AndroidAPS is identified.

Thank you all!

comments.body:
regarding your first issue: From what I read it might be that the libre sensor is "crazy"! Also, maybe some unrealistic calibrations are entered into xdrip!? 
What is your libre reader or official Libre app says?

> regarding your first issue: From what I read it might be that the libre sensor is "crazy"! Also, maybe some unrealistic calibrations are entered into xdrip!?
> What is your libre reader or official Libre app says?

Thank you! 
The libre reader was near!
Yesterday, i reinstall Xdrip, import Database and import the inicial settings backup that i have when i change to the Samsung. 
At the moment is working great!

@Amtmagalhaes Are you still having problems?
Can we close this issue?
You can consult with the user community using the support channels.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
